segments.text: In modern society, immigration is a topic that cannot be avoided
The number of people moving across borders has continued to rise significantly
Receiving countries show various reactions
Some welcome immigrants, others reject them
Politicians often turn this issue
Into a political point of dispute
The challenges that immigrants pose are multiple language, culture, religion and economy
Friction between the receiving society
And new immigrants may occur
But looking back at the history of immigration
We see that they have made many contributions to their receiving countries
The prosperity of America was built by immigrants from around the world
There is also wide variation among immigrants
Some move voluntarily for economic reasons
Some flee war or persecution as refugees
Some come to reunite with family
They cannot be grouped together
The welcoming attitude of a society
Has a great effect on the integration
Of immigrants
In a society that coldly rejects newcomers
Immigrants become isolated
And sometimes turn to extremism
What solves this most effectively is education and dialogue
A society that does not fear difference but learns from it
That is the key that opens the 21st century
